items.content_text: ### Research & Scientific Inquiry / Data Visualization * [geoai-skills (⭐30)](https://github.com/muend/geoai-skills) by [muend](https://github.com/muend) - Skills for geospatial analysis that require coordinate-system, spatial-validation and comparability checks before a result is reported, and narrow or refuse a claim the data cannot support. Ships a paired evaluation against a skills-disabled control arm.\        ### Design & UI/UX / Data Visualization * [i18next-localization (⭐244)](https://github.com/i18next/i18next-cli) by [i18next](https://github.com/i18next) - Agent [Skill (⭐244)](https://github.com/i18next/i18next-cli/tree/main/skills/i18next-localization) that takes an app from hardcoded strings to a localized one with i18next: stack detection, config, AST-based wrapping of strings in `t()`, key extraction, sync to Locize and AI translation. It regenerates the step-by-step prompt from the installed i18next-cli, so it cannot drift from the CLI.\

items.title: Awesome Rust
items.content_text:
### Applications / Security tools

*   [rbenaley/Vauban (⭐92)](https://github.com/rbenaley/Vauban) - Privileged-access bastion for SSH, RDP, industrial protocols, and AI agent tool calls.

### Development tools / Static analysis

*   [tool-bunker/code-buster (⭐53)](https://github.com/tool-bunker/code-buster) - A deterministic offline static analyzer for repository structure, dependencies, dead code, duplication, complexity, security, and maintainability across 18 languages. [![CI](https://github.com/tool-bunker/code-buster/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/tool-bunker/code-buster/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Libraries / Artificial Intelligence

*   [Gilfeather/furnace (⭐65)](https://github.com/Gilfeather/furnace) \[[furnace-server](https://crates.io/crates/furnace-server)] - Pure Rust inference server for ONNX models, built on Burn [![build badge](https://github.com/Gilfeather/furnace/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Gilfeather/furnace/actions/workflows/ci.yml?query=branch%3Amain)
*   [SyntaxSpirits/rust-lstm](https://github.com/SyntaxSpirits/rust-lstm) \[[rust-lstm](https://crates.io/crates/rust-lstm)] - LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU and peephole LSTM networks with backpropagation through time, SGD/Adam/RMSprop optimizers, learning rate schedulers, dropout and zoneout. [![Rust](https://github.com/SyntaxSpirits/rust-lstm/actions/workflows/rust.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/SyntaxSpirits/rust-lstm/actions/workflows/rust.yml)

### Libraries / GUI

*   [artemtsitronov/glacex (⭐110)](https://github.com/artemtsitronov/glacex) \[[glacex](https://crates.io/crates/glacex)] - GPU-rendered, immediate-mode UI library with SDF rendering and persistent widget state.

items.title: Awesome Gbdev
items.content_text:
### Compilers / Misc

*   [LLVM-Z80 (⭐62)](https://github.com/llvm-z80/llvm-z80) † - A fork of LLVM with a backend for the Game Boy CPU (SM83), supporting the latest C standards and LLVM’s excellent optimizations.

### ASM / Boilerplates and libraries

*   [gb-vwf](https://codeberg.org/ISSOtm/gb-vwf) - Library to print variable-width text, comes with a demo.
*   [gb-boilerplate](https://codeberg.org/ISSOtm/gb-boilerplate) - A template for starting Game Boy projects, providing a Makefile for infrastructure.
*   [gb-starter-kit](https://codeberg.org/ISSOtm/gb-starter-kit) - An expansion on the above, including base library code as well to get started faster.
*   [rgbds-structs](https://codeberg.org/ISSOtm/rgbds-structs) - A macro pack that provides struct-like functionality.
*   [rgbds-arrays (⭐1)](https://github.com/Rangi42/rgbds-arrays) - A macro pack that provides array-like functionality.
*   [regex.inc (⭐4)](https://github.com/evie-calico/regex.inc) - A regular expression parser in assembly macros.

### ASM / Syntax highlighting packages

*   [gbz80-highlight](https://codeberg.org/ISSOtm/gbz80-highlight) - Notepad+- and gedit syntax highlighting files for RGBDS assembly.
*   [Aevilia](https://codeberg.org/ISSOtm/Aevilia-GB)

### Demos / Syntax highlighting packages

*   [Game Boy Demospotting](https://privat.bahnhof.se/wb800787/gb/) - An archive of Game Boy software demos made from 1996 to 2020.

### Commands & Extensions

*   [Thinking Methods (⭐15)](https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills) - Curated Agent Skills (SKILL.md) for structured thinking on real decisions: five whys, pre-mortem, trade-offs, prioritization, six thinking hats, and twelve more methods plus a selector skill. Install as a Gemini extension (`gemini extensions install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills`) or skills only (`gemini skills install https://github.com/ysskrishna/ai-agent-skills.git --path skills`). MIT.
